## 2026-09-01T11:07:27 — FLAW_TRIAGE: Flaw scan round 2026-09-01

Round 2026-09-01 — 56 cross-reviews → 8 self-triages

### Upgrades accepted (aggregate)

**Factory Engineer triage:** 7 med reviews converge on worktree pool maturity: inventory without verify-per-tree, registry binding, or adapt handshake. No high severity. Core gap is proving pool + external proof loop, not more peer_loop refactors.

**Verify Runner triage:** 3 high: role bleed (implement work assigned to verify niche), verify gate failures blocking factory, no parallel verify. Consensus: stay read-only, own execution speed and first-failure reporting.

**Adapt & Heal Specialist triage:** 1 high on external proof prerequisite. Hub fingerprint heal detected but not closed; registry repos lack profiles. Adapt is upstream gate for factory capex.

**Research Analyst triage:** 2 high: executable queue demotion stalled; duplicate external proof and factory phase lines persist. Success = fewer peer-executable items with clear acceptance criteria.

**Queue Steward triage:** 4 med: sync maintained but dirty-tree item conflates solved dispatch-unblock with optional hygiene; duplicate factory items inflate noop risk.

**OSS Integration Architect triage:** 5 high — highest factory blocker. Zero external proof loops; registry RAM/CaaS/CPT lack artifacts. Investment thesis unvalidated until one adapt→native-verify→PR completes.

**Performance Tuner triage:** 6 med: quick cache partial; dual daemon; verify still sequential. Perf wins should target verify wall-clock and external proof cycle time.

**Safety Auditor triage:** 5 med: role scope bleed — assigned git hygiene not SAFETY_GATES audit. continue_on_dirty design needs PASS/BLOCK on worktree isolate, not dispatch unblocking.
- **Factory Engineer:** Auto ensure-pool when count < worker_target
- **Factory Engineer:** Run verify gate scoped to worktree cwd before merge

- **Factory Engineer:** Yellow-tier safety gate before foreign-repo worktree add
- **Verify Runner:** Parallelize independent verify_commands with fail-fast

- **Adapt & Heal Specialist:** Run automation_adapt --all --heal --write --quick on registry gaps
- **Adapt & Heal Specialist:** Bump registry status when profile+verify_commands land
- **Adapt & Heal Specialist:** Read-only probe default on revenue repos; require --write consent
- **Research Analyst:** Collapse 4 external proof bullets into one ordered registry sprint
- **Research Analyst:** Add acceptance criteria per queue line (registry status, verify cmd, PR URL)
- **Research Analyst:** Demote LOOP_STRATEGY echoes to notes only — not queue work
- **Research Analyst:** Mirror registry.json status fields in queue dispatch view
- **Queue Steward:** Split dirty-tree: [x] continue_on_dirty dispatch vs [ ] optional WIP commit
- **Queue Steward:** Auto-demote queue items when registry status advances
- **Queue Steward:** Hard-fail pre-dispatch on WORK_QUEUE ↔ self_improve_context drift
- **Queue Steward:** Shrink queue when fingerprint unchanged 3+ cycles
- **OSS Integration Architect:** Pick RAM (active-loop-running) as first target this sprint
- **OSS Integration Architect:** Run adapt→native verify→worktree PR end-to-end with registry proof note
- **OSS Integration Architect:** Mandatory safety PASS before registry status advance
- **OSS Integration Architect:** Script twice-without-babysitting loop as peer_tasks template
- **Performance Tuner:** Propagate --quick through run_local_cycle and run_verify_gate
- **Performance Tuner:** Wire HEAL_ACTIONS to stop duplicate ram-peer-loop when hub healthy

## 2026-09-02T20:27:12 — FLAW_TRIAGE: Flaw scan round 2026-09-02

Round 2026-09-02 — 56 cross-reviews → 8 self-triages

### Upgrades accepted (aggregate)

**Factory Engineer triage:** Reviews converge on: external proof before kit polish, GLink compaction on dispatch hot path, lazy imports for RSS, pre-dispatch adapt check delegation.

**Verify Runner triage:** Reviews converge on: stale green during cooldown, missing adapt-stale block, need structured fail codes and per-worktree native verify.

**Adapt & Heal Specialist triage:** Reviews converge on: Newdrop needs-kit-install is critical path, fingerprint stale despite done queue items, foreign probe must update registry.

**Communications Engineer triage:** Reviews converge on: bus.jsonl bloat (6110 msgs), English SUM payloads, need schema validation and rotation.

**Queue Steward triage:** Reviews converge on: 6 theater items blocking fingerprint advance, duplicate external-proof lines, drift heal reads hub not worktree.

**OSS Integration Architect triage:** Highest priority: Newdrop/CaaS needs-kit-install — adapt→native verify→PR is unvalidated investment thesis.

**Compression Engineer triage:** Reviews converge on: bus.jsonl is biggest uncompressed artifact, peer_loop import graph cold RSS, full-repo safety scans wasteful.

**Safety Auditor triage:** Reviews converge on: role bleed (daemon ops vs SAFETY_GATES), eval() in tests must BLOCK, foreign worktree secret scan missing.

**Efficiency Research Agent triage:** Reviews converge on: cooldown stale green, noop loop from theater queue, micro-opts don't move external proof.

**Output Research Agent triage:** Reviews converge on: factory_progress inflated without external artifact, duplicate integration lane, queue theater blocks advance.
- **Factory Engineer:** Emit GLink DIFF after orchestrate edits; cache assign_worker_pool for stable queue_fp; lazy-import heavy peer_loop modules; delegate adapt heal to adapt_specialist lane
- **Verify Runner:** Block PASS when automation_adapt --audit warns fingerprint stale; honor test_cache_ttl; emit structured fail_code on first failure; classify hub vs external verify blockers
- **Adapt & Heal Specialist:** Run automation_adapt --heal --write on registry target; bump registry status after profile+verify_commands land; chain verify after every heal
- **Communications Engineer:** Archive bus tail >500 lines; add payload size validator; emit compact SUM {fp
- **Communications Engineer:** open
- **Communications Engineer:** n} after queue sync
- **Queue Steward:** One demotion pass for theater items; collapse external-proof to single integration bullet; auto-close verify items when last_cycle ok
- **OSS Integration Architect:** One cycle: kit-install → native verify in worktree → irreversible PR → registry proof note; tag worktrees with registry namespace
- **Compression Engineer:** Bus rotation as primary deliverable; lazy-import peer_loop modules; scope safety scan to git diff paths
- **Safety Auditor:** BLOCK eval() at tests/test_peer_repo_research.py:66; separate daemon-health from audit queue; scan install.sh before foreign copy
- **Efficiency Research Agent:** Enqueue test_cache_ttl honor in verify path; measure external-proof cycle time not hub micro-opts; one scoped item per cycle with file paths
- **Output Research Agent:** Single registry sprint bullet with proof_ref pattern; defer hub research until integration_architect PR exists; feed OUTPUT_RESEARCH with verify+registry tuple

### Downgrades rejected (aggregate)
- **Factory Engineer:** Dual-daemon proof demotion — still needed for Mac+hub parity until one external proof lands
- **Verify Runner:** Skip self-check entirely during cooldown — still need periodic full verify
- **Adapt & Heal Specialist:** Full probe skip when fingerprint unchanged — still need audit on git churn
- **Communications Engineer:** Msgpack line mode now — premature until message rate exceeds threshold
- **Queue Steward:** Zero open queue target — need minimum executable backlog for peer dispatch
- **OSS Integration Architect:** Defer all hub kit work — factory still needs daemon stability fixes
